name: comp_ai_power_global_2026-09-25
strategy: Bet that the AI capex bottleneck sits in physical power, not chips: grid transformers, switchgear, cables, turbines, liquid cooling and the HBM that feeds the racks. Every name has a dated observable inside Oct 12-Nov 13 (GEV/NVT/VRT prints, ASML Oct 14, TSMC Oct 15, SK Hynix/Samsung late Oct, Hon Hai Tech Day Oct 30-31, Cameco Nov 3-4, Siemens Energy and Korean grid names mid-Nov). I would be wrong if a hyperscaler capex digestion headline, a China export-control shock, or a de-escalation-driven risk-premium compression hits the whole chain at once, since these names are highly correlated to one AI-power factor.
what_i_did_not_buy: ALB|12 target cuts, lithium spot down, no dated catalyst in window
NVO|Morgan Stanley downgraded to Sell, structural share loss to Lilly
INTC|Government equity stake legal challenge unresolved, no dated catalyst
IONQ|35x forward sales, chronic ATM dilution, no dated catalyst
ORCL|Force-majeure data-center notice, 8 target cuts, AI financing stress
